results.title: F1 reveals 2027 calendar as Monaco joins expanded sprint schedule
results.description: F1 has unveiled its 24-race calendar for the 2027 season, increasing the number of sprint weekends to 10, as it kicks off the season in Bahrain and finishes in Abu Dhabi. results.title: F1 announce 2027 calendar and increase in Sprint rounds
results.description: Formula 1 has announced its 2027 calendar and an increase in the number of Sprint weekends from six to 10, with the season starting in Bahrain.

results.title: Erie Otters defenseman Ty Henry due back after season-long knee injury
results.description: Ty Henry, a Chicago Blackhawks draft pick, is back with the Erie Otters after a knee injury idled him throughout the OHL's entire 2025-26 season.
